name: paperbanana
description: Generate publication-ready methodology diagrams and statistical plots for academic papers with PaperBanana's multi-agent pipeline. Bundles the PaperBanana MCP server and skills to generate, refine, evaluate, and package paper figures.

google_api_key.title: Google Gemini API key
google_api_key.description: Used by the default Gemini models. Get one at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. Leave empty to use GOOGLE_API_KEY from your environment or a project .env file.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Only needed for OpenAI models (gpt-5.2, gpt-image-1.5, gpt-image-2). Leave empty to use OPENAI_API_KEY from your environment or a project .env file.
